text: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE. Leading manufacturers push the returnability decision to the point of diagnosis in the dealership, so an invalid return never enters the network. Inspection findings are captured as structured defect codes rather than narrative, which makes the return stream usable as a quality signal. Several publishers report that claims settlement within 5 days is typical of leading players.
